cohort: 3074 women who achieved singleton pregnancies after fresh embryo transfers in their first in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) cycle
finding: The presence of first-trimester subchorionic hematoma (SCH) detected at 6-8 weeks of gestation was not significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes in singleton pregnancies following fresh embryo transfers.
mod_finding: The study found no significant association between first-trimester subchorionic hematoma and mode of delivery.
